profile: Per-scene profiles; explicit reference-layout scenes retain edge roads and fences without the default eight-world-pixel guard. See each scene's profile and framing.
rebuild_note: Rebuilt from the current reference-guided grass/compound inputs; user visual approval remains open. Historical generation recipes retain their original provenance.

guard.policy: reference-layout: eight-world-pixel band is diagnostic only; no rejection or fade; final compound union mask clips outside after density resampling

scenes.profile: compound-v1: pre-allocation resource budget <=4,000,000 conservative full-support axis taps: (scene_width_4x+scene_height_4x) * (ceil(6*max(1,1/(4*uniform_scale)))+1), including out-of-source normalization work; <=32,000,000 retained weight bytes plus <=32,000,000 temporary kernel bytes; reject before weights allocate. Uniform whole-source pixel-edge affine to full 4x scene; transparent extension; separable antialiased premultiplied byte-RGB Lanczos3, signed lobes, source-space radius widened by reduction, output-only rounding and existing alpha/color clamp policy. Outer union boundary formed by reciprocal edge cancellation; explicit reference-layout framing: preserve full affine source at the requested inset; report the eight-world-pixel boundary band diagnostically without rejection or fade. Existing resizeLanczos filters full unmasked 4x artwork to whole-scene 2x before final union clipping. Ground independently exported by exportConnectionTiles with fixed geometry and grass only, PNG decoded and assembled at exact tile origins; never sampled at scene origin. Compose artwork globally over actual ground PNG assembly, mask union only at final pixels; crop without filtering, final complementary top-left half-open ownership. Decode tile PNG bytes and reassemble ordinary image.Draw Over. Both runtime line parities use actual PNGs, ground first, compound second. Pixel-aligned 2x/4x only; no runtime/whole-map/user acceptance claim.
